sourceTitle: The Privateer's-Man, One hundred Years Ago
description: "The Privateer's-Man, One Hundred Years Ago" by Captain Frederick Marryat is a historical novel written in the early 19th century. The story follows the adventures of a young privateer, detailing his life at sea during a time of piracy and naval conflict, particularly focusing on his experiences while serving on the privateer Revenge.
